---
title: "Markets"
subtitle: "Gold and silver against the pre-registered planetary indicators"
description: "World Bank monthly gold and silver prices with indicator activity by month, and the distribution of forward-move classes during and outside each indicator."
---

The upper panel is the monthly average price from the World Bank's Commodity
Price Data (the "Pink Sheet", CC BY 4.0) on a log scale. The orange bands show
how much of each month the selected indicator was active, computed from the
daily flags of the study (darker means more of the month). The lower panel
asks the study's question in a simpler form: after days when the indicator
was active, did the next weeks' move fall into a different part of the
distribution than after other days?

::: {.af-howto}
**How to read this.** Every trading day's forward move (5, 21 or 63 trading
days ahead) is placed into one of five equal-sized classes, from the lowest
fifth (1) to the highest fifth (5). If the indicator carried no information,
days during the indicator would spread evenly, about 20% in each class, just
like days outside it; the thin rule marks 20%. Bars that rise above the rule
in class 5 and fall below it in class 1 would point to stronger moves during
the indicator. The heatmap splits the same comparison by year (red: more
frequent during the indicator than outside, blue: less), which shows whether
any difference is steady or confined to a few years. Prices from Yahoo
Finance used by the study are not republished; only these classes and signs
are.
:::

```{ojs}
pink = FileAttachment("../data/pinksheet_monthly.json").json()
goldDaily = FileAttachment("../data/market_gold.json").json()
silverDaily = FileAttachment("../data/market_silver.json").json()
```

::: {.af-filters}

```{ojs}
viewof metal = Inputs.radio(new Map([["Gold", "gold"], ["Silver", "silver"]]), { label: "Metal", value: "gold" })
```

```{ojs}
daily = metal === "gold" ? goldDaily : silverDaily
viewof indicator = Inputs.select(new Map(daily.indicators.map((d) => [d.label, d.id])), {
  label: "Indicator", value: metal === "gold" ? "jupiter_retrograde" : "venus_retrograde"
})
```

```{ojs}
viewof horizon = Inputs.radio(new Map([["5 days", 5], ["21 days", 21], ["63 days", 63]]), { label: "Forward horizon", value: 21 })
```

```{ojs}
viewof chart = Inputs.radio(["Bars", "Violin", "Heatmap by year"], { label: "Chart", value: "Bars" })
```

:::

```{ojs}
spec = daily.indicators.find((d) => d.id === indicator)
days = {
  const c = daily.columns, q = c[`fwd${horizon}_q`];
  return c.date.map((t, i) => ({
    date: new Date(t + "T00:00:00Z"), month: t.slice(0, 7), year: +t.slice(0, 4),
    active: c[indicator][i] === 1, cls: q[i], up: c.sign[i] > 0, extreme: c.extreme[i] === 1
  }));
}
monthShare = d3.rollups(days, (v) => d3.mean(v, (d) => d.active), (d) => d.month)
  .map(([m, share]) => {
    const a = new Date(m + "-01T00:00:00Z");
    return { a, b: d3.utcMonth.offset(a, 1), share };
  })
firstMonth = days[0].month
prices = pink.columns.month.map((m, i) => ({ date: new Date(m + "-15T00:00:00Z"), month: m, price: pink.columns[metal][i] }))
  .filter((d) => d.month >= firstMonth && d.price != null)
STATES = ["During the indicator", "Outside it"]
classShares = STATES.flatMap((s, k) => {
  const v = days.filter((d) => d.cls != null && d.active === (k === 0));
  return [1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((cls) => ({ state: s, cls, share: v.length ? v.filter((d) => d.cls === cls).length / v.length : 0, n: v.length }));
})
stateColor = (s) => (s === STATES[0] ? palette.active : palette.inactive)
```

```{ojs}
priceChart = {
  const w = Math.max(340, Math.min(width, 1200));
  const plot = Plot.plot({
    width: w, height: 280, marginLeft: 60, marginRight: 24, style: plotStyle,
    x: { type: "utc", label: null },
    y: { type: "log", label: `${metal === "gold" ? "Gold" : "Silver"}, USD per troy ounce (log)`, grid: true },
    color: { type: "identity" },
    marks: [
      Plot.rect(monthShare.filter((d) => d.share > 0), {
        x1: "a", x2: "b", fill: palette.active, fillOpacity: (d) => 0.08 + 0.4 * d.share,
        title: (d) => `${d.a.toISOString().slice(0, 7)}: indicator active on ${(100 * d.share).toFixed(0)}% of trading days`
      }),
      Plot.line(prices, { x: "date", y: "price", stroke: palette.ink2, strokeWidth: 2 }),
      Plot.tip(prices, Plot.pointerX({ x: "date", y: "price", title: (d) => `${d.month}: ${d.price.toFixed(2)} USD/oz (World Bank)` }))
    ]
  });
  return htl.html`<div class="af-chart" id="markets-price">${plot}</div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
distChart = {
  const w = Math.max(340, Math.min(width, 1200));
  let plot;
  if (chart === "Bars") {
    plot = Plot.plot({
      width: w, height: 300, marginLeft: 56, marginBottom: 44, style: plotStyle,
      fx: { label: "Forward-move class (1 lowest fifth, 5 highest)", domain: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5], labelOffset: 40 },
      x: { domain: STATES, axis: null, paddingInner: 0.25, paddingOuter: 0.35 }, y: { label: "Share of days", tickFormat: "%", grid: true },
      color: { type: "identity" },
      marks: [
        Plot.barY(classShares, { fx: "cls", x: "state", y: "share", fill: (d) => stateColor(d.state), rx: 4, insetLeft: 1, insetRight: 1,
          title: (d) => `${d.state}, class ${d.cls}: ${(100 * d.share).toFixed(1)}% of ${d.n} days`, tip: true }),
        Plot.ruleY([0.2], { stroke: palette.ink2 }),
        Plot.ruleY([0], { stroke: palette.axis })
      ]
    });
  } else if (chart === "Violin") {
    plot = Plot.plot({
      width: w, height: 320, marginLeft: 56, style: plotStyle,
      fx: { domain: STATES, label: null },
      x: { label: "Share of days (mirrored)", tickFormat: (v) => `${Math.abs(v * 100).toFixed(0)}%` },
      y: { domain: [0.6, 5.4], label: "Forward-move class", ticks: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] },
      color: { type: "identity" },
      marks: [
        Plot.areaX(classShares, { fx: "state", y: "cls", x1: (d) => -d.share / 2, x2: (d) => d.share / 2,
          fill: (d) => stateColor(d.state), fillOpacity: 0.85, curve: "catmull-rom" }),
        Plot.ruleX([-0.1, 0.1], { stroke: palette.ink2, strokeOpacity: 0.6 }),
        Plot.dot(classShares, { fx: "state", y: "cls", x: 0, r: 2, fill: palette.ink,
          title: (d) => `${d.state}, class ${d.cls}: ${(100 * d.share).toFixed(1)}%`, tip: true })
      ]
    });
  } else {
    const byYear = d3.groups(days.filter((d) => d.cls != null), (d) => d.year).flatMap(([year, v]) => {
      const a = v.filter((d) => d.active), o = v.filter((d) => !d.active);
      return [1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((cls) => ({
        year, cls, nA: a.length,
        diff: a.length >= 10 && o.length >= 10
          ? a.filter((d) => d.cls === cls).length / a.length - o.filter((d) => d.cls === cls).length / o.length : null
      }));
    });
    const ext = d3.max(byYear, (d) => Math.abs(d.diff ?? 0)) || 0.1;
    plot = Plot.plot({
      width: w, height: 260, marginLeft: 56, marginBottom: 40, style: plotStyle,
      x: { label: null, tickFormat: (y) => (y % 5 === 0 ? String(y) : "") , type: "band" },
      y: { label: "Forward-move class", domain: [5, 4, 3, 2, 1] },
      color: { type: "diverging", range: palette.div, domain: [-ext, ext], pivot: 0, legend: true,
               label: "Share during minus share outside", tickFormat: "+%" },
      marks: [
        Plot.cell(byYear, { x: "year", y: "cls", fill: (d) => d.diff ?? NaN, inset: 1, rx: 2,
          title: (d) => `${d.year}, class ${d.cls}: ${d.diff == null ? "fewer than 10 days on one side" : `${(100 * d.diff).toFixed(1)} points`} (${d.nA} days during)`, tip: true })
      ]
    });
  }
  return htl.html`<div class="af-chart" id="markets-dist">${plot}</div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
chart === "Heatmap by year" ? htl.html`` : swatchLegend(STATES.map((s) => ({ color: stateColor(s), label: s })))
```

```{ojs}
tiles = {
  const a = days.filter((d) => d.active), o = days.filter((d) => !d.active);
  const pct = (v, f) => (v.length ? (100 * v.filter(f).length / v.length).toFixed(1) + "%" : "n/a");
  return htl.html`<div class="af-status">
    <div class="af-status-item"><h4>${pct(a, (d) => d.up)} vs ${pct(o, (d) => d.up)}</h4>
      <span class="af-status-state">Up days during vs outside the indicator</span></div>
    <div class="af-status-item"><h4>${pct(a, (d) => d.extreme)} vs ${pct(o, (d) => d.extreme)}</h4>
      <span class="af-status-state">Extreme-move days during vs outside</span></div>
    <div class="af-status-item"><h4>${a.length.toLocaleString()} of ${days.length.toLocaleString()}</h4>
      <span class="af-status-state">Trading days with the indicator active</span></div>
  </div>`;
}
```
